column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rule overrides: <rule id> TAB <IGNORE|INFO|WARN|FAIL> TAB <reason>.
# Any alert not listed here fails the zap-baseline job. Reasons: docs/security/supply-chain.md.
# Not a weakness: API responses are no-store on purpose (authenticated data).
# Not a weakness: the CSP nonce and CSRF token are random base64 values by design.
# Informational: the app is a single-page application, so ZAP suggests the AJAX spider (already on).
# Concerns headers in requests sent by ZAP itself, not server behaviour.
# Product decision pending: img-src allows any https: image; narrowing it needs an image-source policy.
# Product decision pending: COEP require-corp would block Google sign-in, Google Fonts and remote images.
